findings.invariant_violated: initiated action must complete or be visibly interrupted
findings.description: After the right hand lifts a coin out of the front cup at 00:02.25, both hands bring coins to the cup rims, as if to drop or insert them (right hand at the front cup, left hand at the rear cup from about 00:03.25). For the remaining ~6.5 s the hands stay in that poised pose and no coin is released, inserted or withdrawn, while the camera keeps orbiting. The drop or insert action is set up and then never resolves. This could be an intentional held pose, so confidence is low.
